source_method_note: Transfer the readability discipline of strong film storyboards, animation thumbnails, manga paneling, and production notebooks; do not imitate any one artist's look. Every panel must communicate task, obstacle, readable action, reaction, and changed state before final-looking rendering.

allowed: public film and animation production notes
published film-staging and editorial craft references
excluded: any prior local frame as a quality or shot-design template
quality_reference_policy.local_asset_boundary: Local selected character, prop, and location assets may constrain identity, wardrobe, weapon, and geography only; they are not visual-quality or blocking references.

method_references.title: Disney Animation Story
method_references.lesson: thumbnail narrative, emotion, timing, staging, and framing before final layout

method_references.title: Disney Animation Layout
method_references.lesson: stage characters, sets, props, camera, cut relation, point of view, and continuity shot by shot

method_references.title: Academy: How To Storyboard Star Trek
method_references.lesson: make an action sequence legible as approach, conflict, recovery, and payoff

method_references.title: Star Wars Jedi Videomatics
method_references.lesson: test action flow, screen direction, and edit rhythm as a moving storyboard before final imagery

method_references.title: ILM Art Department: Concept Art and Storyboarding
method_references.lesson: treat storyboards as an action and logistics blueprint for the finished shot

method_references.title: Jump Manga School Lecture 3
method_references.lesson: use wide shots for position and distance, closer views for hand performance and emotion, and keep each panel immediately readable

premise_one_sentence: Ashe must stop the man who raised him without handing him a straight path to execution; the order becomes a physical split, then the defenders' own movement forces one controlled disarm.
reader_hook: An order is given; before anyone charges, the battlefield visibly splits into lanes.

scene_engine.task_or_desire: Contain Lonato while protecting the village route and preserving Ashe's chance to choose restraint.
scene_engine.obstacle: A two-guard screen and a broken wet crossing prevent a direct approach.
scene_engine.escalation: The guards move first; Catherine takes their pressure; Lonato steps across only to cover a retreating guard.
scene_engine.visible_change: The ordinary sword lies in the mud, Lonato is on one knee, and the witnesses remain back rather than turning the stop into an execution.

characters.distinctive_behavior: low hand signal and off-screen authority
characters.effect_on_others: students form a barrier and do not rush

characters.tactic: nock toward empty ground, then lower
characters.effect_on_others: the guard line hesitates and Catherine enters

characters.tactic: intercept the nearer guard first, then receive Lonato's protective press
characters.effect_on_others: the guard pair retreats and Lonato loses his ordinary sword

characters.goal: protect the rebellion and the guard
characters.tactic: shield-led step across the retreat lane
characters.effect_on_others: his cover position creates the one safe bind and the disarm

beats.task: Byleth's command must become a physical containment plan
beats.obstacle: the crossing forks and the guard screen is not yet formed
beats.cause: The command redirects Ashe before the guards can be allowed to open a direct lane.
beats.action: Dimitri and Dedue hold cover while two guards close the fork and Ashe is routed right
beats.changed_state: two lanes exist and Lonato is beyond the screen
beats.attention_path: near cover -> guard screen -> far Lonato
beats.payoff_or_handoff: Ashe owns the near-right warning plane

beats.task: Ashe must make a nonlethal warning
beats.obstacle: the guard line blocks the direct path
beats.cause: The two-lane screen leaves Ashe a warning lane but removes a clean shot at Lonato.
beats.action: nock, draw toward empty mud, then lower without release
beats.changed_state: the arrow remains nocked but the attack impulse is refused
beats.attention_path: bow hand -> empty mud -> guard line -> far Lonato
beats.payoff_or_handoff: left gap remains open for Catherine

beats.task: Catherine must stop the guard pressure
beats.obstacle: the nearer guard steps toward Ashe
beats.cause: The nearer guard answers Ashe's warning by pressing into the open lane.
beats.action: enter from left and redirect the long weapon
beats.reaction: near guard staggers sideways; second guard retreats
beats.attention_path: advancing weapon -> Catherine's guard -> displaced pair
beats.payoff_or_handoff: Lonato sees the retreating guard and must choose whether to cover him

beats.task: Lonato must protect his retreating guard
beats.obstacle: Catherine controls the lane and the guard is exposed
beats.cause: The displaced guard retreats behind Lonato, forcing Lonato to cross into the controlled lane to cover him.
beats.action: Lonato crosses to cover the guard; one ordinary-sword press meets Thunderbrand and is turned aside
beats.reaction: the guard gets behind Lonato; the sword drops
beats.attention_path: retreating guard -> Lonato's shield -> weapon contact -> mud
beats.payoff_or_handoff: Lonato's balance gives way into Shot029

beats.task: The stop must land as a human consequence
beats.cause: The disarm removes Lonato's last stable support while the witnesses deliberately hold their distance.
beats.action: catch on shield and settle to one knee
beats.reaction: Dimitri, Ashe, and female Byleth hold back
beats.attention_path: dropped sword -> knee and shield -> distant witnesses
beats.payoff_or_handoff: cut to the aftermath reaction without a victory tableau
